title: Chapter 390: Bird In A Cage
content:
Chapter 390: Bird In A Cage

Yue Shi Shen was looking at the boy in front of him at this moment.

After a long time, he suddenly asked, "Do you know the person on that sign?"

Hearing this question, the boy nodded.

He knew what Yue Shi God meant.

In the temple, the gray-falling sign he picked up from the corner was the tablet of Yueshen God.

However, that is not recognized by the Moon tribe.

But even so, the tablet of the Yue Slayer God is still in the ancestral temple of the Yue clan.

Even though they do not agree, the current Yue clan is protected by the Yue God Slayer, which is a fact that must be admitted.

"The ancestor of the Moon Killing God, he is the most powerful person in the history of my Moon Clan. He was incredible back then and led my Moon Clan to a height that he had never seen before. How could I not know as a member of the Moon Clan?"

Hearing the boy's words, Yue Shi Shen's eyes dimmed a little.

"Do you know, what about him later?"

The young man's expression remained unchanged, "Later, he was defeated in the land of the gods, begging for mercy from the gods, and protecting the last trace of blood in my moon tribe."

Yue Shi Shen looked stunned, and even Lu Daosheng next to him looked at the boy with some surprise.

At this time, the young man sneered and continued, "The mercy of the gods for my Yue clan is only for those oppressed beings. Their real intention is just to let the ancestor of the Yue Shenshen have it. Weakness, so that we can better control him.”

Speaking of this, both Yue Shi Shen and Lu Daosheng were shocked.

This young man is so smart.

How old is he?

This is a talent.

In an instant, Lu Daosheng developed a love for talent.

At the beginning, he wanted to let Yue Shi Shen train this young man, and maybe he could see a good show one day in the future.

But now, he changed his mind.

Of course, this kind of talent is coming to his deserted city.

Before Lu Daosheng could speak, Yue Shi Shen blurted out: "What do you think of this ancestor?"

Upon hearing this, the young man laughed, "Is my ancestor who can control me?"

"I believe that one day, the ancestor will definitely avenge his previous shame. At that time, my moon clan will surely reappear the glory of that year, and even surpass it!"

The boy's eyes were filled with excitement, and his arms were spread high with excitement.

He had never seen the God of Yue Shi, but only learned some of the old people in the clan, and combined with the records in the books, he realized the God of Yue Shi.

But just this is the only thing that he has become very interested in this ancestor he has never met.

He believes in the moon killing God.

"This kid...."

Yue Shi Shen looked helpless, but at this moment, there was a slight smile on his face.

"Since that's the case, then I'll,

Yue Shi Shen finally made up his mind and slowly poked his hand towards the young man in front of him.

But at this moment, a strong and powerful hand grabbed his wrist tightly, making him unable to stretch forward inch any more.

Yue Shi Shen was slightly stunned and looked at Lu Daosheng next to him, with a serious expression.

"Your Mightiness?"

Lu Daosheng chuckled, "I'll save your life, it's not for you to steal people in front of me."

The boy looked at the two of them blankly at this moment and suddenly realized that these two people were not the same.

But what he didn't understand was that judging from this posture, the two seemed to have fallen in love with them.

Is it because of the speech I just made?

"Two seniors, do you recognize the ancestors of my clan?"

Hearing the boy's words, Yue Shi Shen gently mobilized the blood in his body.

In just a moment, the boy was stunned.

He looked at the Yue Shi God, who was only one step away from him in front of him, and his eyes gradually changed from shock to excitement.

This person, this man!

"Old ancestor!"

The boy roared and jumped up in excitement.

The ancestor of the Yue Shen God has actually returned.

"Class leader, where is the Class leader?"

At this moment, he really wanted to ask the patriarch and other tribesmen to come and have a look, and the ancestor who guarded them was back.

But Yue Shi Shen shook his head slightly.

"No need, they won't come."

"Why?"

The boy was puzzled.

But the boy didn't know that just now, the Moon Slayer God not only made him feel the strong blood power, but also made the entire Moon Clan's ancestral land feel it.

However, the fact is that until now, every household has not made any movement.

They knew that Yue Shi Shen was back, but they were not willing to meet.

Although Yue Shi Shen was helpless, he was not very sad.

As long as there is one person in the clan who understands him, that is enough.

The boy was also very smart, and he understood it now.

But he felt sad for a moment, and he recovered, "Old ancestor, please take me away and let me follow you."

The boy suddenly knelt down at Yue Shi Shen and begged.

Yue Shi Shen naturally wanted to agree at this moment, but at this moment, one of his wrists was still tightly grasped by Lu Daosheng.

Lu Daosheng sneered and slowly let go of Yue Shi God.

And at this moment, there was movement in the distance.

"Boy, you can't go with him!"

"Class leader?!"

When the boy heard the sound from a distance, his heart suddenly trembled. When he turned around, he saw the leader of the Moon Tribe with a cold face.

Soon, the patriarch of the Yue clan came to the three of them.

His eyes swept across the boy and Lu Daosheng in turn, and finally fixed his eyes on Yue Shi God.

"My younger generation, Yue Chen, have met the ancestor."

Yue Chen, the leader of the Yue clan, bowed to Yue Shi Shen. Although it seemed very serious, anyone with a discerning eye could see the leader of the Yue clan's casualness.

Although the leader of the Yue clan looks very old and is also the leader of the Yue clan, he is indeed a junior in front of the Yue Slayer God.

Looking at the current generation of patriarchs, Yue Shi Shen nodded slightly, which was considered to be recognized.

Then, Yue Chen came to the boy and said, "Go back with me!"

The leader of the Yue tribe pulled the boy up and wanted to get up and leave.

But this time the boy was abnormal and did not leave with the old man who raised him.

"Class leader, I want to leave here with the ancestor. I can't stay in this broken place for the rest of my life."

Here, there is no future at all.

"You can't go with him!"

The old man roared quietly.

Even though Yue Shi Shen was right beside him, the old man still had no fear.

"Clan, patriarch."

The boy's face looked a little ugly. At this moment, he had already seen the old man's turbid and blood-covered eyes.

At this moment, he hesitated.

He thought of the time when the patriarch raised him.

He had no parents since he was a child, and it was the patriarch who took him in.

Because he is in the patriarch's family, his conditions are definitely high in the village.

Basically, he has what others have, and he doesn’t have what others don’t have.

However, he was unwilling to accept this.

He wanted freedom, and this place, to him, was like a cage, a cage of despair.

What he wants is to spread his wings and fly high!
